info.title: CF ActivityPub API
info.description:
Mastodon-compatible ActivityPub API for this instance.

Authentication uses OAuth 2.0 bearer tokens obtained from `POST /oauth/token` (password grant). Public endpoints (instance metadata, public timelines, WebFinger, ActivityPub federation) do not require a token. Click **Authorize** and paste your access token to try authenticated endpoints.

This document is generated from the actual route handlers in `app/**/route.ts`.

tags.name: Accounts
tags.description: User profiles, follow/unfollow, mute/block, relationships and verification.

tags.name: Statuses
tags.description: Posts, boosts, favourites, bookmarks, pins, context and interaction policies.

tags.name: Timelines
tags.description: Home, public and tag timelines with standard Mastodon pagination.

tags.name: Notifications
tags.description: Notifications for follows, mentions, boosts, likes, polls and edits.

tags.name: Instance
tags.description: Public instance metadata, peers, rules, languages and configuration.

tags.name: Admin
tags.description: Account management, domain blocks, reports and the moderation log. Requires the admin role.

tags.name: Filters
tags.description: Content filters (v1 and v2) with keyword and status rules.

tags.name: Lists
tags.description: Curated lists of accounts and their timelines.

tags.name: Conversations
tags.description: Direct message conversations with read/unread state.

tags.name: Trends
tags.description: Trending statuses, tags, links and the explore feed.

tags.name: Follow Requests

tags.name: Featured Tags
tags.description: Tags a user has featured on their profile.

get.description: Real-time WebSocket stream for timelines and notifications. Open a WebSocket to `/api/v1/streaming?stream=...&access_token=...` and listen for `update`, `notification`, `delete`, `status.update` and `conversation` events.
